reviews.review_description: The in house sales visit was very thorough and professional but this stopped once I paid the bill. Post install support has been absent.Install date was the Friday before of a long weekend. No one turned up. No Phone call. No message. I called and asked what was going on. The electrician didn't turn up for work. A new Install day was nominated on the Tuesday. Again no one came. I messaged the office and a team was redirected on route to another job. They arrived 2 hours late. They could not complete the job on the day as a firmware update was required and was too late to have this done. Another team was due on the following Friday but never turned up on time. They did another job before mine. They turned up 2pm to complete the install. They did the firmware upgrade and complete the install.The system is running well.

Worst ever customer service. Don't even think about to take the service from them. Tried to contact with them about my existing PV system issue and they refused to help me. According to them, I sent email and I never got a reply from him. I called to customer service again they told me it will take 48 to 72 hours to get a response from them and customer service told me they are very busy and they will respond when they will get time. Customer service is not allowing me to speak with any other person in the office and cut the phone.I do not recommend them for any service.

The process from sales to installation was very smooth and professional.  Our house did not lend itself to a solar installation but the installer just saw this as a challenge and found a way to make it work!

Sales quoting process was very good with Roland - sales person - answering all my questions with great professionalism. The installation was punctual as scheduled, quick and tidy. Connection to the grid was completed from the installer.

Very good quote for a Tesla battery, Fronius Symo Inverter and good panels. Installation by their installers was completed in 2 working days and only after about 5 days from when we accepted their quote. We will see how long it takes for their energy supplier to get us connected to the grid.Installers said the actual layout of panels is likely to vary according to roof trusses, etc. But they seemed to fit them on ok.
From the beginning to the end the service and installation has exceeded my expectations. Definitely recommend 100%
On-time, quick, friendly, didn't damage the colourbond roof, very pleased.  The meter change-over was organised and all is well.
Great service from start to finish, was a nice and simple process
A great local company, using local trades and quick installation. Value for money and great systems.

Westside Solar I found extremely efficient, the sales person was extremely helpful and supplied me with all the answers I was needing to make the right decision on the appropriate system for my new home.The system that has now been installed is working brilliantly and I can monitor the results on my IPhone every day, great.

Roland is a professional salesman, wasn't pushy and he even answered my emails during the weekend. Shannon and his team rocked up at 7am as they promised. Wasnt a good weather but the guys finished the work seamlessly and on time. They were respectful and proficient and left no mess at the end of the day. I could have saved a few hundreds to a grand going with online installers with similar tier one panels and the same inverter but I am fully aware why it is a good idea to pick a local installer with a good reputation in the long run. very happy with the system output and I highly recommend Westside.

I chose Westside because they explained the options to me clearly, because they quoted on good quality equipment rather than on price, and then the installation team were great, and system performs very well.

Troy was the only sales person who answered all my questions. He was also professional and polite. When the installers came they recommended a different layout of the panels that was originally designed. Westside altered the design and I upgraded the Inverter at the same time. The installers were fantastic. Joey and Tony made the whole process painless.

No hard sales technique. Great product v price compared to 3 other quotes received. Very informative. Whole process seamless. Installers very professional, polite, cleaned up afterwards. Made a great team. Took time to explain use.Would definitely recommend Westside Energy.

Sales cycle was professional and respectful. Back and forth a few times till they were shortlisted, then stepped up at the last minute to make an offer which closed the deal.Installation was fine, however the inverter was not fully setup and site setup was incomplete by the sub-contractor. Am working through the Service Division and the Distributor to complete this now.As a Renewables qualified electrician (Ret), I was able to liaise with energy suppliers myself.Overall, the experience was pleasant and the information on the SolarQuotes site was very helpful and I was able to choose a SolarEdge inverter from their articles, though I was unfamiliar with that brand till I read about it.

I was recommended to Westside by a friend and was not disappointed.  Nick Mazis explained the solar fantastically and was upfront and realistic about projected savings.Most importantly,  any questions i had after the system was installed were answered quickly and in a friendly and helpful manner.

Everything went really well with Westside Solar.I wanted a system that was quality with ongoing support if needed.Sound advice,no get you to sign up right now prices or pressure.I was specific that I wanted a really good inverter,and high performace tier 1 panels.Really wanted to deal with a local company who would be able to suppott their product if need be.Installation was no problem. Everyone was very efficient and polite. I'm happy.

We went with Westside energy happy with the system 12 ja solar panels and fronius primo inverter however our energy provider has provided exceptionaly poor service it will be a total of six weeks before a smart meter will be fitted as we need an isolation something we didnâ€™t expect and at this point I canâ€™t comment on how well it works ....

After the sales pitch and signing it was poor customer service: inaccurate assessment at site inspection by sales manager (just checked meter board and used google - now have shade issues) serious communication issues internally and with subcontractor, promises made at sale not met, quality issues with installation, smart meter application delayed then wrong. Documentation still not received. Thought I was paying for quality service  but should have gone with a small operator and paid less.

Amazing company, Amiitty is the most easiest person to speak to explained every thing in detail was so caring and helpful on the phone.Paul came to see me and was friendly, and didn't push me to sign on the dotted line I felt totally in control. Nick and the install guys were quick and efficient in there work and updated me on every last detail I highly recommend Westside and the team.
THANK YOU Westside Energy for doing a great job with our solar system , from the quoting and advice through to the installation. 5 stars !!

This installation was a smooth process from engaging Westside Energy, working with the office team and through to site installation.The site team were clean tidy and efficient, carried out a great installation, and left the site as if they had never been there,Would highly recommend Westside Energy.Thanks to the whole team on a great outcome.
Quote was precise and explained properly.Installation by the boys was excellent.They were all very helpful and explained well.

Great job from start to finish i first spoke with Amity who was a pleasure to speak to and very informative. Paul who was a great sales guy and knew the best size and system for us with no hidden costs or extras .Nick the next day called to explain what happens next he was very helpful and kept in contact throughout installation .Everything went smoothly I was kept informed of a small delay of panels but can highly recommend the Company.

The installers had a very awkward roof to work on and the job experience for them was not pleasant, but they pushed through and made a decent install. They were thorough on on all aspects of the job and cleaned up everything which is unusual for sparkies.

Reliable installer, price is reasonable, tradies were professional and did a good job, marketing team is excellent, highly recommendI did not have to do any thing to organise grid connections , they did organise that with Sa power network.

Wow is all I can say great Company. We started with a call from Amity so nice and so helpful we had a discussion about what I wanted and she went above to follow up a few concerns I had then called me back and took time to explain it all and let me know what would happen next.If you are wanting solar  definitely ask for Amity she's amazing. Then Roland what a funny man likes to joke but does his job so well. Took all are concerns and explained everything didn't hurry us was here well over 2 hours and never once hurried us to buy.Rolands the best Sales guy ask for him if you want a happy bubbly guy. Nick was helpful and very professional on the phone told us step by step the procedure Installation guys also great no issues Have no issue referring any of my family or friends ...

Salesperson was new and provided 3 key pieces of information which turned out to be false. After much stress and emailing, and phone calls and a visit to the office I received a refund for the Emberpulse (the salesperson told me that it would work without WiFi - which was incorrect) and an agreement to refund the price of the meter upgrade (the salesperson told me that this was undertaken at no charge which again was incorrect). He also had out of date figures for the feed-in tariff. Very disappointing. The manager apologised and refunded me an additional $100 to make up for all the hassle.

When i first put in for Solar  I thought I would be harrassed by company's for days which I was by company's not even in Adelaide. Westside energy are not like that from my call with Amity who was the nicest person to talk to, she let me rant about being overwhelmed by it all and talked to me about everything for 45 minutes. She treated us like people not a sale she  explained step by step what will happen when Roland visited. Well Roland is the most honest down to earth salesman I've ever meet he to explained it in detail and took time with me and my husband .Next was Nick who organised step by step what would happen.Next  Installation guys were there no issues cleaned up and then explained it all have referred them to all my friends cannot speak more highly of them.

I cannot rave about this company enough! They were amazing throughout. Roland is the best salesman there ever will be. He explained everything in thorough detail and explained what energy providers would give me the best deal. Next person is Nick once I paid the deposit I got a phone call the following day to set up an installation day which was the following week. The installation guys couldnâ€™t find the place at first but once they did they told me where the panels would go, where the inverter would go, told me to sign and off I went to work no problems, come home and voila solar! Again canâ€™t thank Westside Energy enough, you guys have been amazing and I will highly recommend you to anyone!!

When the salesperson mentioned they use employees not contractors I was surprised. That's pretty rare. It heavily influenced my decision to use them. Only after the work was done did I find out the installers were contractors. Too late for me. The installers barely spoke to me. Ended up putting the system in a different spot from where I wanted it. Left rubbish on the roof and around the property. Didn't explain where and how they would install everything. Then when I took my issues to Westside they couldn't have treated me with more contempt. I just didn't want the same thing to happen to anyone else. But Westside threatened legal action for my payment. Now I don't trust them, the workmanship or the supposed warranties. So I have no idea if they installed what they promised. I'm confident if I have any issues with my system they will avoid dealing with them, as they effectively did with my complaint.

The quality of the system & service is outstanding! I have used other systems for my business & home and Westside Energy is by far the best. The prices are reasonable along with the tradespeople & actual system. Cannot rate them any higher. You pay for what you get!

The salesman travelled over 100km to asses my needs and quote. Many others just priced it up over the phone.. The installation was as promised,  professional, neat and a great bunch of guys. I am so happy with everything, a rare comment from me in this day and age. Thoroughly reccomend Westside Energy, would use them again in a heart beat.

The whole exercise has been stress free thanks to Salesman Paul Mills  and the staff at Westside Energy.  Also  the installers, Endre, Brandon and Johanna, were a pleasure to deal with. They had to work around some very windy and wet weather,  but maintained their professionalism at all times.Friendly  and trustworthy. So far, so good!

Found Westside on Google and from my initial Call to Amity who was so helpful,went above to help me out was a lovely person and was great to speak to. Roland was are Sales guy and answered all my questions and was also helpful and explained it all in detail. Likes a joke so had me lauging which made me more relaxed. The rest of the Team have been more then helpful small issue came up  and they dealt with it ASAP no hesitations. Recommended this company all the way.
your advice was invaluable to compare providers particularly the point of getting assistance to connect to the network.
fantastic installer - Matthew Reichens Electrical  -highly professional, helpful and explained everything I needed to know.

Great Customer Service I spoke With Amity So helpful Eased my Concerns about a few things Took her time with me And never once made me feel like i was just a $ Symbol I was treated like a Customer and can't recommend her enough to. Paul was just as good Took his time with me Explained it all in detail and showed us Our roof and how are Panels will look Which I thought was great. Cannot recommend Westside as a whole enough I have great Confidence that if anything was to go wrong I will be helped.

Amazing Kind Customer Service Person Amity Helped me through my call. She Was patient with all my questions explained how Westside Work and just chatted away to me and helped me understand Solar a bit more. I would recommend If you want a helpful friendly person to assist you without getting overwhelmed by it all Ask for Amity. Paul Mills was our sales guy and what a champ, Wasn't a pushy Guy which was my concern that it would be to overwhelming for me. He explained everything to me in detail and took his time with me so i understood it all and was more than happy with everything. Amity, Paul and Westside I highly recommend to all my friends and Family. Will update when my systems installed but if this is the great service so far I'm so impressed.

From first contact With Amity who was friendly, Kind and so helpful Pleasure to deal with took her time with us To the Sales Person Roland who didn't pressure us and answered all our Questions and Concerns and helped us get a good price and Quality System We are now awaiting are Installation but will highly recommend Westside Energy to fiends and Family .
The installers were professional and happy to discuss the installation and answer questions. It was a top quality job.

So far Iâ€™m extremely pleased and glad I went to Westside energy thebarton everyone is lovely from sales people to Instalers to receptionists they all tick my boxes I have spread the word around to other family members to only go to Nick Mazis at Westside just a good experience all round.

Westside Energy I would recommend to anyone in South Australia. From the beginning to the end the salesmen were friendly helpful l& supplied us all the information we needed. We chose the company because it is a well known Adelaide company & after a bad experience with our first choice we are so pleased we went with Westside. Thank you Nick you explained all in detail for us.

Brilliant - their knowledge, expertise and quality of service second to none and the fact they've been in the industry for such a long time contributed to the decision of going with Westside. System has been in 3 months now and so far has been running flawlessly - loving the savings :)
Westside Energy, in particular their sales man Nick, were fantastic. Everything was explained very clearly and we couldn't be happier with the end result.

Very happy with the service, Westside Energy were not the cheapest but we felt very confident with their information and they helped us through every step of the way. Installation has occurred and we are just waiting for our electricity supplier to do their part with the meter and we will be up and running in the next couple of weeks.

Westide energy was great. The sales rep explained everything extremely well but their customer service side was a bit lax. Called several times and never got call back, booked in installation but customer service rep never entered it in the system.
Not yet installed, we have problem with timbers due to previous white ant damage, which is being repaired.
We have not had the system installed yet and could not put NA in the allotted areas.

There has been confusion about the need for ameter upgrade. Information given by Westside was ambiguous and had some difficulty getting info from Origin. Outcome is we don't need an upgrade as have an existing albeit smaller system which is being replaced. I expected installer and Westside to know this.System is being installed next week so hope all goes well.Appreciated your help re sorting what from chaff.

Westside came out and actually viewed my property. They talked me through my options and I am happy with the decision I made, especially as I have shading issues. Josh who did the installation was great and really knew his stuff. Looking forward to downloading the App and seeing how itâ€™s all going.
Installation scheduled for next week.Details of our experience sent via earlier email a few week ago.
Still waiting to get smart meter installed

Salesman Steve was a great help because he knew just what I wanted.  Paid a deposit and was a little disappointed the install date was cancelled on two occasions after I had taken the  time of work to be at home.  Install day went smoothly which was a Saturday and is now operating for two days.  Rubbish was cleaned up but placed into our log fire bin for us to get rid of.  Nice people though and easy to get on with.  All in all to date all is well.
All went smoothly, with no problems
Salesman great. Installers efficient and helpful. Good information. Office staff rather disorganised.System seems to be working really well - this is only one week after installation.
Professional from beginning to completion, would recommend.

The Sales Person was very good at explaining what would happen and when. All the Contractors were very Professional and new what they were about. Everything is working well and we were able to extend the Warranty from 5 years to 10 years for no extra cost. My only concern was that the Electrician who set up the WiFi Controller Solar Web and my iPhone App has failed and I can no longer Monitor the generation of Solar Energy that the Solar Panels are Supplying.

The customer service Westside Energy offer is outstanding. From the first phone call, to the sales team, and the contractor that did the pre inspection to the install was Awesome. I would recommend them to anybody that values customer service and ease of doing business to give them a go.

Steve Alexander. Sales & Operations Manager , Westside Energy provided comprehensive advice , expert service and know how with highly competitive pricing and quality outcomes. A company with in depth experience and for whom I have complete confidence.
We would especially like to thank the installer, Dino. A more polite, tidy & hard worker would be hard to find. Thank you !
Westside was easy to get on with. Steve (sales) was great. Installation happened very quickly. We are just having issues getting our meter changed which is the fault of Origin.

We were very disappointed when it came to the service around the installation. Initially we were told they would be at our house between 8am and 9am. At about 10am when they hadn't arrived and we had heard nothing, I phoned the Westside solar and they checked with the installer and then said they were held up at another job and would now be arriving at about 12 noon. At 1.30pm when they hadn't arrived and we hadn't heard from them, I then phoned to see what was happening. I was told the installer would be phoned and they would get back to me. I received a phone call from another Westside employee to say sorry and they would certainly get things sorted quickly. Within 5 mins of that telephone call the girl I initially spoke to phoned back to say the installer was not answering their phone and she would phone me as soon as she heard from them. Then the phone rang and it was to tell me the installer would arrive in 15 mins. 3/4 hour later at 3.30pm they finally arrived. When they arrived it was full steam ahead until the rain brought it all to a halt at about 5pm. We were then told they would be back the next day (Saturday) but that it wouldn't be until afternoon because they had "another job booked for the morning"  At 3.30pm with still 'no show' my husband phoned the installer and finally they arrived about 4pm saying they "had car trouble". The job was then completed. I did send an email to Westside solar and received an apology but to be honest I was a bit disappointed that was all that was offered.  NRG Solar's Salesman was very impressive and really did all the hard work with explaining everything in detail and if his quote had been lower, he would have won the job. It would have been interesting to see how their installation process compared.
Neat install with no corners cut.  Friendly staff
Our Panels were not able to be erected where the sales person had indicated; because the installers were not given enough panel supports. The installers were disappointed about this aspect.

Installed system a couple of days later than expected, which caused some issues in obtaining a day off though found the installers to be professional and removed rubbish on completion. Recently installed smart meter and turned on system to determine that the inverte is showing some State codes, which relate to high voltage so contacted Westside and waiting for feedback to this problem. Will update once rectified.
Thanks for the three recommendations - resulting in 3 prompt quotes. Excellent comparisons to allow best choice. Your service was the foundation to that all. Gratitude and thanks.

Westside carried out a very detailed technical assessment at our location.Track record and company stability.Installation delay due to our side - building work.The company I work for also interacts with Westside Mechanical - so there is quite a connection.

Remu explained everything regarding the solar system really well, listing positives and negatives we may encounter with particular solar systems / tiers 1, 2 and 3 systems and was really forthcoming and honest regarding information and history of the company etc. Real breath of fresh air to come across an honest sales person, more interested in customer satisfaction then simply wanting to make an extra buck!

Signed up 19 Jan 2018, installation booked for 20 Feb. (no problem), organised with my employer to have this day off, by 9.30am i rang Westside to see whats going on, i was told they would be here at 12.30 and would be able to complete the job that day, eventually contractors (not Westside) turned up at 2pm and obviously were not going to finish that day. Very unhappy , my company has a major defence contract which requires me to be on site because of the security clearances i have, so having another day off caused great inconvenience. Tue.6 March, haven't heard from anyone about my meter reconfiguration, my wife rang AGL (account holder) only to find out this was done 19 Feb! My question is, couldn't the electrician who set all this up, and tested on the 21 Feb, have realised the system was fully functional? Two other items i have concerns over,the manager of westside called me (after i made calls to express my dissatisfaction) and offered a $100 gift voucher,to which i have not received,secondly, my sewer vent was cut back to facilitate installation of panels,is this standard practice?Steve Pluck  Happy valley.
Neat Tidy Professional install. will recomend

The Process started well with the sales rep arriving on-time and having already famiiarised himself with the house.  The sales person took great pains to explain that his background was as an INSTALLER not a salesperson and identified the best layout of panels according to the span of roofing screws on my iron roof.  Fantastic, I thought and we designed a system around available roof space which I was assured would be possible and straightforward.  The price was good and I was more than happy to pay a deposit and organise installation.So Installation day comes around, my wife organises a day off work so she can be home during installation and the installers arrive and begin to setup.  Shortly after they declare that they are unable to complete the installation because the roof is too steep and lacks sufficient access and harness points.  They apologise, pack up and depart.  I don't begrudge the installers as they shouldn't perform work in conditions that they feel is unsafe - that is self evident.I do however have a massive issue with the quotation process and the glaring oversight on the salespersons behalf about the access issues.  There are many solar companies that don't visit a property to provide a quote and the reason I wanted Westside to quote the job is because they inspect the site thereby (i thought) answering fundamental questions like 'Are our installers going to be able to safely complete the job?'  I find this oversight especially astonishing as the sales person was himself an installer and should therefore be able to identify any possible safety issues.So thankyou Westside Energy for giving me the complete runaround through simple oversight at the time of quoting.  I shall go back to the drawing board and find another installer.

The first problem occurred close to the install date when we discovered that the selected panels were not available, so we agreed to an alternative.When the installers arrived we were told that the alternative panels had not been  delivered on time, then we  were told that the panels would not be arriving at all.After some time we were told that we would have to pay more and finally they reneged on the deal based on spurious and defamatory reasons, stating falsely that I upset the installer who would not return to the property. (During this period I was in contact with the installer who was very happy to provide advice and was the only person providing communication).Finally after 4 weeks and after threatening legal action they refunded my deposit.
We have ordered our system but itâ€™s not yet installed. This company have assured high quality panels and a quick installation. We await the install next week!

Westside Solar........... Excellent solar install.I contacted Westside Solar and there Sales Manager Steve Alexander came to our home and completed a quote.What was important to my wife and I was not only a quote but the time taken to fully explain their proposal in plain "English".They provided a comprehensive quote / document and took the time to explain all.No fast talk and what was clear was they know their product, market and provided a fully comprehensive system and solution.Installation completed, no fuss, no mess, NO PROBLEMS.Excellent overall and we now have a system that is supported with WIFI allowing us to see how the system is performing daily and supported via a daily email as to what electricity we are generating and using allowing us to see performance etc.Highly recommend Westside Solar.RegardsRobNORTHGATE ADELAIDE SA 5085
